posts.title: Technics RS-M10 Capacitor Replacement
posts.description: I noticed that my Technics RS-M10 cassette deck from 1979 had that nasty green corrosion coming from a capacitor. Also inspecting the board underneath showed a trace that was damaged. Even though only one brand seemed to leak, I replaced all the electrolytic capacitors, since they are close to 50 years old now.
